meta.name: history-portability
meta.description: Import Claude Code or Codex history and move complete CCAM datasets between machines. Use when rescanning provider history, importing a copied directory, uploading JSONL or archives, exporting a backup, restoring it idempotently, or verifying that tokens, workflows, runs, rules, and pricing survived.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 备份并迁移 Claude Code 和 Codex 的历史记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要在多台电脑之间保留 AI 编程助手的使用记录
copy.tagline_en: Back up and migrate Claude Code and Codex history across machines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to preserve AI coding assistant history across multiple computers

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 可导入 Claude/Codex 历史,并把整套 CCAM 数据集导出为文件后恢复到另一台机器。恢复不会覆盖已有会话;新会话携带 agent、事件、token 用量、工作流;run、规则和定价记录缺失时才写入。
howto.when: 当你说要导入或重新扫描历史、导出/上传/恢复备份,或要核验 token、工作流、规则等是否完整时。

say.text: 请重新扫描 Claude 的历史记录。
请把 /backup/ccam-export.json 恢复到这台机器。
say.note: 执行 ccam import-data,不会覆盖已有会话。

say.text: 请导出当前 CCAM 数据为备份文件。

howto.what_en: Imports Claude/Codex history and exports/restores full CCAM backups. Restore is idempotent, non-destructive: existing sessions skipped; new sessions add agents, events, token usage, workflows; missing run/rule/pricing rows inserted.
howto.when_en: When you need to import provider history, upload or restore backups, or verify key CCAM data such as tokens, workflows, rules, etc. survived.

say_en.note: Runs ccam import-data; skips existing sessions.

say_en.text: Please export current CCAM data as a backup file.
